title: Filtered constructible maps with factorization and relations
statement: Let X be a qcqs scheme and Lambda a finite commutative ring, and F a Lambda-module sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. There exist a small filtered category A, a diagram D of constructible module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], and a cocone iota to F. Every map p:G -> F with G constructible factors as q followed by iota_a. If p:G -> D_a and q:G -> D_b have equal composites to F, there exist c and arrows f:a -> c, g:b -> c with D(f) p = D(g) q. This asserts a construction with factorization and refinement of relations, not its colimit universal property.

proof.text: For every constructible sheaf use exists_affine_free_etale_presentation. Index all pairs of finite families of etale objects and morphisms between their finite sums of free sheaves. This index is already a Type (u + 1), since X.Etale and the sheaf Hom types have that size. Every constructible sheaf is isomorphic to the cokernel of one of these morphisms by uniqueness of a cokernel colimit. ObjectProperty.Small and EssentiallySmall therefore give an essentially small full subcategory of constructible sheaves. No affine-etale skeleton is required at the larger universe u + 1 used in this statement.

proof.text: Compare IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf with the library IsConstructibleSheaf by isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff. The zero sheaf is constructible using the trivial stratification and zero constant values (the proved library lemma IsConstructibleSheaf.of_isZero). Constructible biproducts and cokernels follow from IsConstructibleSheaf.biprod and IsConstructibleSheaf.cokernel. Form B = CostructuredArrow P.ι F for the constructible object property P. Zero gives a member of B. A biproduct with its induced map to F gives a common successor. For parallel arrows f,g use the cokernel of f-g; their triangle equations ensure the map to F descends, and the cokernel condition equalizes the arrows. This proves B filtered. Mathlib StructuredArrow.Small makes B essentially small. Transport to SmallModel B and compose its inverse equivalence with the projection and inclusion to define D. The structure maps to F define iota; triangle commutativity proves naturality.

proof.text: A constructible map G -> F defines an object of B. The unit of the small-model equivalence gives its factorization into the diagram. For the relation clause, regard p and q as arrows in B from (G,p followed by iota_a) to the objects above a and b. Use filteredness first to take a common successor, then to equalize the resulting parallel arrows. Postcompose with the equivalence unit at this equalizing object, and use fullness of the inverse equivalence to obtain arrows out of a and b in SmallModel B. Applying the forgetful functor to the equalizing equation gives exactly p followed by D(f) = q followed by D(g).

theorem exists_filtered_constructible_data
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    ∃ (A : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory A) (_ : IsFiltered A)
      (D : A ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
      (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const A).obj F),
      (∀ a : A, IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf (D.obj a)) ∧
      (∀ (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
        IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf G → ∀ p : G ⟶ F,
          ∃ (a : A) (q : G ⟶ D.obj a), q ≫ ι.app a = p) ∧
      (∀ (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
        IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf G → ∀ (a b : A)
          (p : G ⟶ D.obj a) (q : G ⟶ D.obj b),
          p ≫ ι.app a = q ≫ ι.app b →
          ∃ (c : A) (f : a ⟶ c) (g : b ⟶ c), p ≫ D.map f = q ≫ D.map g)
